summary.headline: Make the project easy to resume.
summary.description: A compact dashboard renderer for project state, evidence, risks, workflow health, skill outputs, and the next action.
summary.checkpointText: Project: Project Workflow. Phase: Build. Status: dashboard template is generalized and ready for Project Context binding. Evidence: PROJECT.md, PLAN.md, docs/project-workflow-v1-accepted-blueprint.md, validation/dashboard-template-static-review.md. Next action: bind the dashboard renderer to compact context data.
summary.footerNext: Bind dashboard cards to real Project Context outputs before plugin packaging.

context.Identity: Project Workflow; private repository workspace for focused skills and a reusable status dashboard.
context.Purpose: Reduce repeated context, clarify prompts, preserve project state, and make the next action obvious.
context.Status: Draft skills exist; static dashboard QA is complete; real Project Context binding is the current milestone.
context.Goals: Refine focused skills, bind dashboard rendering, validate behavior, then package as a plugin.
context.Scope: Usage Gauge, Project Checkpoint, Prompt Cleanup, Execution Planner, Project Structure, Project Status, Workflow Health, reusable dashboard.
context.Constraints: Local-first evidence, compact checkpoints, no hardcoded model catalog, no dashboard-as-source-of-truth.
context.Checkpoint: main at 018eee8 after dashboard merge and Project Checkpoint/Usage Gauge updates.

definitionOfDone.text: Dashboard renders compact Project Context without duplicating the whole blueprint.
Missing optional fields hide their cards rather than showing empty filler.
Residual risks and pending external coverage remain explicit.
A future continuation can start from the dashboard and checkpoint without rereading long history.

sequence.purpose: Verify the current project phase, completed work, and open risks.
Choose surface, model, reasoning, tools, plugins, and skills from available capabilities.
Estimate qualitative usage intensity and identify one safe saving move.
Commit, save, or hand off only after validation evidence is recorded.

prompts.title: Validate current dashboard binding
prompts.label: best
prompts.text: Review the Project Workflow dashboard with the included Project Context fixture. Verify minimal and populated rendering, missing-card behavior, tabs, copy controls, and mobile layout.

prompts.title: Update project checkpoint
prompts.label: scope lock
